tools.name: get_grant_program_info
tools.description: Eligibility, fees, the fee waiver, the current cycle's dates and how to apply for the Gift of Parenthood grant. Use this before telling someone about the program.

tools.name: start_grant_application
tools.description: Prepare a Gift of Parenthood grant application for the person you're helping and email them a link to finish it. Send their email plus anything they've told you. tools.name: start_gift
tools.description: Prepare a gifted grant application (a nomination) for someone else and email the giver a link to review and pay. single_cycle pre-pays one application; four_cycle_pass pre-pays up to four over a year. The recipient is only invited after the giver pays. Nothing is paid by this tool.
